communityIntro: Hands-on programmes, holiday clubs and workshops for young people, families and adults in Darlington. Come along to make something, learn a new skill, get outdoors, or turn your idea into a business.
title: Our Programmes
subtitle: Empowering young people and adults to create, connect, and grow.

programmes.title: Makers to Market
programmes.description: Free 12-week programme, funded by The National Lottery Community Fund: develop, brand and sell your handmade products at real markets.

programmes.title: Brand Lab
programmes.description: Our holiday club for ages 8–11: see the brands, T-shirts and commercials our young designers created.

programmes.title: Maker Days
programmes.description: Hands-on project days for home-educated children aged 8–16: design it, model it, pitch it.

programmes.title: Hustle Hive Rangers
programmes.description: 10 weeks of maps, trails and outdoor skills for ages 8–16.

programmes.title: Creatureverse: Rift Battles
programmes.description: Design your own creature, 3D print and paint it, make trading cards and battle in a final tournament.

programmes.title: ECO//FUTURE
programmes.description: Design a sustainable home from a client brief and build it as a scale model. For home-educated young people.

programmes.title: Outdoor Resilience & Mentoring
programmes.description: Outdoor mental health and resilience days, plus one-to-one mentoring for young adults moving from school to work.

programmes.title: Outdoor Education & Wellbeing
programmes.description: Nature-based learning, teamwork and wellbeing activities

programmes.title: After-School Programme
programmes.description: Creative, skill-building activities for ages 11–16, after school

programmes.title: Entrepreneurship Hub
programmes.description: Startups and side-hustles: mentorship, co-working, and workshops.
